name: Task Panel
description: Exec-mode Today tab: live task board + axes + est-presets + calendar cache served over taskpanel.* RPCs. Replaces Todoist. Split from tinkerclaw-control-panel 2026-07-24; keeps the same SQLite store.

dataDir.description: Directory holding the task-board SQLite store. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/data/control-panel/ (the pre-split location — live data).

calendarSync.description: Calendar sync configuration. Default: google.primary at 30 min cadence.

briefingImport.description: If true, the morning briefing's task manifest is auto-imported via taskpanel.tasks.import. Default: true.

dataDir.label: Data dir
dataDir.help: Where the task-board SQLite store lives.
